content: Is there a supported way to load Batteries.CodeAction for every file in a Lake project, without adding an import to each file? I want the Batteries induction/cases code actions project-wide, and I cannot find any guidance on how to do this online.

Although you used the words "load" and "import", there is only one Lean mechanism for that: import. However, note that public imports are transitive so you can create a Prelude.lean module that imports all the modules you need in every file. Then you can just import Prelude to simultaneously import modules A, B, C,...

Thanks! I will do this going forward. As an aside, this seems rather inconvenient. Maybe the lakefile should support mechanism to register LSP additions? It seems rather weird to have to register LSP settings in my source code rather than my projects configuration file/build script.

The pattern described above (I think Init.lean is a more common choice of name?) is the simplest option that is available. I agree that there's a gap in core tooling here. If you look at Mathlib, CSLib, or Iris-Lean, you'll find implementations of the same idea of checking that some import is available in (almost) all modules of a project.
